in_hebrew.name: יִבֶרֶשׁ_בֶן_יוֹנָת
in_hebrew.meaning: God is my helper, son of Yonah
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Iverson' can be derived from the Hebrew roots 'יִבֶרֶשׁ' (yivreš), which means 'God is my helper', and 'בֶן' (ben), meaning 'son'. The name may be interpreted as 'God is my helper, son of Yonah', reflecting the belief in divine assistance and protection.

in_greek.name: Ιβερσών
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the name 'Iverson' is 'ΙβερΣΩΝ'. This name can be translated as 'Helper of God', emphasizing the idea of divine aid and support.

in_latin.name: Iversus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name 'Iverson' is 'Iversus'. It derives from the Latin word 'vertere' (to turn), and the suffix 'us' (belonging to). The name 'Iverson' can be understood as 'helper', reflecting the concept of assistance and support from a higher power.
